generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of seeing your own studies that will serve you across the rest of your degree. Each placement, project or practical task is a chance to learn by doing, to build real skills and to find out what the work is really like. The habit to keep is simple: treat every piece of real work as learning, take part fully, and notice what it teaches.

That same habit carries into working life. Wherever you are given real tasks and the room to learn from them, the people who get the most are the ones who treat the work itself as learning. The way of learning you have just seen is one you will use long after you graduate.
